retained_records.title: DNS Cache Recovery - Guide 1
retained_records.content: If Wi-Fi is connected but internet access is unavailable, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and test again.

retained_records.title: Re-create VPN Profile - Guide 1
retained_records.content: Remove the damaged VPN connection profile and create a new profile using the approved organization settings.

retained_records.title: Re-register MFA - Guide 1
retained_records.content: If MFA approvals or codes fail, remove the old authenticator registration and complete the organization's approved MFA registration process again.

retained_records.title: Password Reset Process - Guide 1
retained_records.content: Use the approved password reset portal, create a compliant password, and sign in again after the reset completes.

retained_records.title: Clear Print Queue - Guide 1
retained_records.content: Stop the print spooler, clear stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and try printing again.

retained_records.title: Update Device Drivers - Guide 1
retained_records.content: Install manufacturer-approved device drivers through the approved update channel and restart the computer.

retained_records.title: Approved Software Installation - Guide 1
retained_records.content: Download the installer only from the approved internal source and install it with authorized administrator permission.

retained_records.title: RDP Credential Repair - Guide 1
retained_records.content: Remove saved Remote Desktop credentials and reconnect using the current organization account.

retained_records.title: Restart Network Adapter - Guide 2
retained_records.content: Disable and re-enable the Wi-Fi network adapter, then reconnect to the approved wireless network.

retained_records.title: Renew Windows IP Address - Guide 3
retained_records.content: For Wi-Fi connected with no internet, run ipconfig /release followed by ipconfig /renew, then reconnect to the wireless network.
